# Laya-MLX runtime — fully-resolved, hash-pinned lock for the
# Apple Silicon (arm64 macOS) laya-mlx virtualenv. Do not edit by hand.
#
# server/services/layaMlx.js (explicit install) installs this with
# `--require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all:`, so every transitive package is version- and
# hash-pinned and a tampered or substituted distribution fails the install.
# There is no install-time resolution: a host this lock does not cover is
# reported as unsupported before anything is installed.
# laya-mlx itself is the commit-pinned archive; hatchling below is its locked build backend.
# Universal across CPython 3.11+ (filelock's security fix needs 3.11), arm64
# macOS wheels only. A cross-platform resolve is not a runtime certification.
#
# Regenerate after editing requirements-laya-mlx.txt, from the repo root,
# with uv >= 0.13.4 and a cooldown so brand-new releases are not adopted the day
# they publish:
#   LOCK="$PWD/scripts/requirements-laya-mlx.lock.txt"; TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
#   cp scripts/requirements-laya-mlx.txt "$TMP/"
#   printf '[project]\nname = "laya-mlx-lock"\nversion = "0"\n[tool.uv]\nenvironments = ["sys_platform == '"'"'darwin'"'"' and platform_machine == '"'"'arm64'"'"'"]\n' > "$TMP/pyproject.toml"
#   (cd "$TMP" && uv pip compile requirements-laya-mlx.txt --universal --python-version 3.11 \
#     --generate-hashes --no-header --annotation-style line \
#     --exclude-newer <UTC date at least 7 days ago> -o "$LOCK")
# then check the result against OSV (including MAL- malicious-package records).
# This lock was generated with --exclude-newer 2026-11-03.
